sentences.en: The kid drew back from the frog when it moved.
sentences.zh: 这只青蛙动了一下，小孩便退后了。

sentences.en: The guide told the kids not to take a picture.
sentences.zh: 导游告诉孩子们不要拍照。

sentences.en: I had a hard time putting the kid to bed.
sentences.zh: 我费了好大劲才把孩子哄睡着了。

senses.zh: 小孩，儿童，少年，小山羊，小山羊皮制品
